sn35.207-209:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkham atītam anāgatam paccuppannam || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhutam sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā dukkhā || || Kāyo || || Mano dukkho atīto anāgato paccuppanno || || Yam dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama Neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
